assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: modular 2D game sprite PARTS atlas, NOT a contact sheet of complete armed heroes. Genuine transparent background. Crisp chunky SNES pixel art with navy outline. Exactly 3 columns x 3 rows equal square cells, 1536x1536 total, no grid, text, labels, shadows or backdrop. Each cell is a 512x512 registration canvas. Standing body should be about 288px tall, feet around (256,416), head around y128; leave ample space. Face RIGHT. Row 1: three WEAPON-FREE ARMLESS hero body sprites: idle feet planted; same idle body viewed right; same idle body viewed right. Include head torso belt legs boots but NO arms, NO hands, NO weapons; torso shoulders end cleanly under collar, arms supplied separately. Identical head and torso dimensions in all three; only first body is used in prototype. Row 2: ONLY one isolated far/support arm per cell, detached sprite with rolled sleeve, forearm and closed gripping hand, no body. Left arm pose supports a horizontal gun, middle supports 45degree upward gun, right supports vertical upward gun. Row 3: ONLY one isolated near/trigger arm per cell with sleeve forearm and gripping hand. Left bent elbow for horizontal gun, middle raised for45degree upward gun, right raised for vertical upward gun. Arms anatomy matches hero, body remains upright. On all arm-only cells start shoulder near (230,240), put gripping hands approximately horizontal(335,285), diagonal(320,210), up(280,160). No weapons or weapon fragments ANYWHERE. These are detached animation layers not amputated characters, no gore. Generous transparent space. Maintain same pixel density across parts. TONY matches reference dark swept spiky hair, light stubble, navy rolled-sleeve buttonfront WORK SHIRT, teal work trousers, brown workboots utility belt. NO overalls, no bib, no shoulder straps. Reference supplies face identity/pixel style only; remove its baked weapons and arms from body row.
